review.images: Aldar’s corporate project page identifies the sunset apartment-building lead render. The remaining scenes are from the Wilds Residences launch gallery and apartment and amenity sections. Kept the apartment release separate from the earlier villa and mansion phases. Corporate page: https://www.aldar.com/properties/en/uae/dubai/the-wilds-residences
review.location: The Reelly-hosted Aldar brochure physical page 7 shows the project area and published 25-minute estimates to Dubai Airport and Dubai Mall. The official project marketing identifies the airport as Dubai International. The apartment entrance is not identified by coordinates.
review.floorPlans: Original eight-page PDF SHA-256 matched the existing source. Visually verified pages 2–4 and both duplex plans on pages 6 and 8. Pages 5 and 7 are duplex introduction spreads. Unmeasured Bayut examples were not assigned to the drawings.

unavailable: Confirmed individual building entrances and signed unit total areas.
